task: ae.rsync: rsync-style delta sync with rolling checksum, strong-hash verification, checksummed wire formats and atomic directory sync
reasoning_summary: Designed sender/receiver messages first (Signature, Delta) with CRC-sealed wire formats and a SHA-256 end-to-end digest. The encoder accepts a weak-checksum hit only after strong-hash verification and prefers copies contiguous with the previous one. Tests include a crafted weak collision, truncate/flip loops, resealed structural corruption and randomized edit round trips; mutating the strong check or the roll formula made tests fail.
